settings.heading: Get in Touch
settings.description: Have a question or need help? Fill out the form below and we'll get back to you within 24 hours.

settings.question: What are your delivery times?
settings.answer: Standard delivery takes 3-5 working days. Express next-day delivery is available for orders placed before 2pm.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel my order?
settings.answer: Orders can be changed or cancelled within 1 hour of placing them. After that, contact us and we'll do our best to help.

settings.question: Do you offer gift wrapping?
settings.answer: Yes! Add gift wrapping at checkout for £5. Your item will arrive beautifully wrapped with a personalised note.
